answer: Five graders stamp each new agent with a pigment hash of its funding path and host cues. Matching hashes share one island that climbs a spiral bond: seat n locks 4n+4 tokens, so the first seat is 8. One honest join costs 8; 1,000 sybils on that island pay 2,006,000 tokens (sum of 4k+4 from 1 to 1000), or 250,750 times one seat. Weakness: a fresh pigment per sock stays at 8. Fix: merge islands that share a funder within three hops onto the same spiral before charging the bond.
